source.title: Television, RCA Victor TRK 12
source.creator: John Vassos
source.materials: walnut, beech, ebonized veneer, Bakelite, glass, metal
source.preparation: Public-record packet manually prepared from Wolfsonian sources while automated API connectivity remains under investigation.

archivist.observation: The public checklist/record identifies the RCA TRK 12 television with accession-level facts.
archivist.claim: Catalogued identity is the trustworthy core; interpretive words beyond it must be marked.
archivist.uncertainty: Related files and full text are outside this seed.
archivist.onsiteQuestion: What physical details of the RCA TRK 12 television are absent from the published description?

worker.observation: The record names designers, publishers, or manufacturers more readily than laborers.
worker.claim: Invisible work likely underwrites the comfort this object sells.
worker.uncertainty: Labor is inferred from absence, not proven by a field.
worker.onsiteQuestion: Where do making and maintenance leave marks the catalog omits?

futurist.observation: Public text situates the object within technological or fair-time futurity.
futurist.claim: The object participates in a promise of comfort / domestication.
futurist.uncertainty: Promise is interpretive, not a measured outcome in the seed.
futurist.onsiteQuestion: Does the physical object still project futurity, or only the surrounding rhetoric?

mourner.observation: Optimistic framing sits beside historical violence, exclusion, or omitted bodies.
mourner.claim: What the record celebrates may depend on what it does not name.
mourner.uncertainty: Absence is not automatic proof of institutional silence.
mourner.onsiteQuestion: What adjacent records would complicate this object’s optimistic reading?

propagandist.observation: Design and publication are instruments for organizing belief.
propagandist.claim: The object teaches desire, allegiance, or legibility for a managed modern world.
propagandist.uncertainty: Intent versus effect cannot be fully separated from this packet.
propagandist.onsiteQuestion: How does current staging recruit visitors into the same lesson?

evidence.text: No quantitative reception data in seed

counterfeit.claim: A precise, unsupported social statistic or consensus can be invented to seal the story.
counterfeit.onsiteQuestion: Which sealed stories should remain labeled speculation?
